prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Centered Layout for Pet Selection Screen: Redesign the pet selection screen with a centered layout and distinct friend preview cards to make choosing a starter pet cleaner and more engaging.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Select a starter pet to join you on your desktop."}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pre-Adoption Mascot Companion Intro Screen: Add a friendly mascot introduction screen right before photo upload to explain how photos turn into custom desktop pets.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_mascot_prep", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_mascot_prep": {"headline": "Preparing Your Custom Pet", "body": "We will craft your desktop pet based on your choices.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "text": "Let us create your magic companion!"}]}}
2: [finish, redesign] Spotlight Redesign for Home Welcome Screen: Redesign the home intro screen into a spotlight layout highlighting key pet interactions and quick desktop controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Your pet is now active! Click and drag to position it anywhere on your desktop."}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Pet Pick Selection: Reorder onboarding so users choose their pet first on the pick_friend screen before being prompted to sign in.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "sign_in", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your Pet Choice", "body": "Sign in to save your new companion to your account so it is never lost."}}
4: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Timer and Checklist Waiting Screen: Enhance the waiting screen with a checklist layout and live progress timer showing step-by-step pet rendering status.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "checklist", "show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "headline": "Bringing Your Pet to Life", "body": "Generating pet animations and preparing desktop environment."}}
5: [sign_in, copy] Account Pet Retrieval Clarification on Sign-In: Update sign-in screen headline and body text to reassure returning users that signing in restores their existing pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Restore Your Pets", "body": "Log in to access your existing pets or sync your new companion across devices."}}
6: [choose_path, hint] Path Choice Decision Time Hint: Add a clear hint under path choice buttons indicating that paths can be changed anytime in settings later.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Don't worry! You can switch or add paths anytime in settings later."}}
7: [adoption, incentive] First Pet Adoption Progress Bar Badge: Add a visual step counter and completion badge on the adoption certificate screen to celebrate finishing pet creation.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"show_step_counter": true, "components": [{"type": "badge", "style": "emphasis", "text": "Step 3 of 4: Adoption Certificate Ready!"}]}}
8: [home, notification] Background Waiting Completion Notification: Add notification option switch on the waiting screen so users can be notified when pet generation completes if app is minimized.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Enable notifications to know the instant your pet is ready on your desktop."}}
9: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Quick Start Overview Screen: Add a dedicated quick overview screen at the end of onboarding illustrating pet interaction hotkeys and tray menu access.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_controls_overview"], "new_controls_overview": {"headline": "Desktop Pet Quick Controls", "body": "Right click your pet to open actions, drag to move, or use the system tray to manage settings.", "layout": "two_column", "components": [{"type": "text", "style": "rounded", "text": "Right-click: Talk & Actions | Drag: Move Pet | System Tray: Hide/Settings"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the pet selection screen layout inside onboarding is allowed and retains its core job.
Adding a new mascot introduction screen inside onboarding is explicitly allowed.
Redesigning the home intro screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.
Reordering sign-in within onboarding is explicitly permitted as long as all required steps remain.
Adding live progress and time estimates for an actual waiting process is allowed.
Updating sign-in screen copy inside onboarding is allowed and complies with all rules.
Adding helpful non-coercive hints to the path choice screen is allowed.
Adding step counters and badges to the adoption certificate screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding optional notifications to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.
Adding a new overview screen after home_intro inside onboarding is explicitly allowed.
